findings.location: source.html paragraph: "It is as though you are in a vehicle traveling 90 mph..." (English) / translation.html paragraph: "Det är som om du sitter i ett fordon som kör i 140 km/h..." (Swedish)
findings.source_quote: It is as though you are in a vehicle traveling 90 mph, and you push the accelerator a little harder, and nothing happens.
findings.suggested_fix: Either keep the original numeric example literal (e.g., "90 mph") or convert it precisely (90 mph ≈ 145 km/h). For Swedish readership a conversion is acceptable, but preserve equivalence. Suggested Swedish wording: "Det är som om du sitter i ett fordon som kör i cirka 145 km/h och du trycker gaspedalen lite hårdare…"
findings.translation_quote: Det är som om du sitter i ett fordon som kör i 140 km/h och du trycker gaspedalen lite hårdare, men inget händer.

findings.location: source.html paragraph: "In a sense, Mrs. Jones was dealing with kidney burnout—a situation where they were putting out more than they were taking in and suffering as a result." / translation.html paragraph: "I viss mening handlade fru Jones om njurutmattning – en situation där de gör av med mer än de får in och lider till följd av det."
findings.source_quote: In a sense, Mrs. Jones was dealing with kidney burnout—a situation where they were putting out more than they were taking in and suffering as a result.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify subject and make wording idiomatic Swedish while keeping meaning. Suggested Swedish wording: "I viss mening handlade det om njurutmattning hos fru Jones – ett tillstånd där njurarna gör av med mer vätska än de får in och därigenom skadas."
findings.translation_quote: I viss mening handlade fru Jones om njurutmattning – en situation där de gör av med mer än de får in och lider till följd av det.
